description: Creating the minutes draft from the template: status, existing minutes and sources.
precondition: Meeting in progress or ended; secretary actor.

preconditions: Ended meeting with Chair and Secretary assigned.
No minutes exist for the meeting.
A reviewed draft exists.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.return: New Draft revision 1 with content built from the records and the reviewed draft; BuiltFromDraftAt = the draft change time; 201 MSG395.
cases.log: Saved: minutes row (Draft, revision 1) with template content, BuiltFromDraftAt and creation time.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
A Draft revision exists with the Secretary's own edits.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: true.
cases.return: Content rebuilt from the records and the current draft; the Secretary's edits are discarded; 201 MSG395.
cases.log: Saved: content, BuiltFromDraftAt and UpdatedAt replaced on the existing revision.

preconditions: Actor reads no meeting (not organizer, approver or participant).
cases.inputs: meetingId: that meeting; actor: the stranger; rebuild: false.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 with no message code; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor's account is deactivated.
cases.inputs: meetingId: an Ended meeting the actor manages; actor: deactivated Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.return: Failure Inactive; 403 with no message code; nothing saved.

preconditions: Ended meeting the actor can read.
Actor is an ordinary Member (neither Chair nor Secretary).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the Member; rebuild: false.

preconditions: Meeting still in Draft status (not started).
Actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
A Draft revision already exists.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.return: Failure Exists; 409 MSG399; the existing draft is unchanged.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
The latest revision is WaitingApproval.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: true.
cases.return: Failure Locked; 409 MSG400; a sent revision is refused even with rebuild.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
The latest revision is a Draft correction of the issued text (it replaces an issued revision).
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: true.
cases.return: Failure CorrectionRebuild; 409 MSG456; the correction keeps its issued content for hand editing.

preconditions: Ended meeting with no minutes; actor is the current Secretary.
A simultaneous request builds the first draft at the same time.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false; the database's one-minutes-per-meeting index rejects the save.
cases.return: Failure Exists; 409 MSG399; the other request's draft stands.
cases.log: Warning logged: concurrent creation for the meeting; the existing draft stands.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
The database fails while saving the new draft.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; actor: the current Secretary; rebuild: false.
cases.log: Error logged with the meeting id.
